name: Why does log home interior staining cost so much more than regular painting?
description: Log staining often costs more because prep, wood condition, and finish type matter a lot. Restoration work can raise the price well above a simple repaint.

mainEntity.name: Why does log home interior staining cost so much more than regular painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the size of the interior, how much prep is needed, and whether the project is a refresh or a full restoration. Published Colorado log-home maintenance pricing shows that prep-heavy restoration can cost significantly more than basic recoating, so hidden damage or old finish removal can change the price a lot.
